title: 螺旋矩阵 III
summary: 从网格内指定位置开始，按东南西北方向向外螺旋行走，返回按访问顺序遇到的全部网格坐标。
insight: 移动长度序列为一、一、二、二、三、三；即每走两个方向后步长加一，途中只记录落在网格内的坐标，网格外仍继续走。
pitfalls: 走出网格不能停止或截断该方向
收集满 rows*cols 个坐标后立即返回

solutions.title: 递增长度螺旋模拟
solutions.idea: 按固定四方向和每两次增加的步长行走。
steps: 循环两次：沿当前方向走 steps 个单位，每步若在界内加入；方向顺时针更新
两方向后 steps++，直到收满网格坐标

code.java: class Solution { public int[][] spiralMatrixIII(int rows,int cols,int rStart,int cStart){int[][] answer=new int[rows*cols][2];int count=0;answer[count++]=new int[]{rStart,cStart};int[][] directions={{0,1},{1,0},{0,-1},{-1,0}};int direction=0,steps=1,row=rStart,column=cStart;while(count<answer.length){for(int twice=0;twice<2;twice++){for(int move=0;move<steps;move++){row+=directions[direction][0];column+=directions[direction][1];if(row>=0&&row<rows&&column>=0&&column<cols)answer[count++]=new int[]{row,column};}direction=(direction+1)%4;}steps++;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun spiralMatrixIII(rows:Int,cols:Int,rStart:Int,cStart:Int):Array<IntArray>{val answer=Array(rows*cols){IntArray(2)};var count=0;answer[count++]=intArrayOf(rStart,cStart);val directions=arrayOf(intArrayOf(0,1),intArrayOf(1,0),intArrayOf(0,-1),intArrayOf(-1,0));var direction=0;var steps=1;var row=rStart;var column=cStart;while(count<answer.size){repeat(2){repeat(steps){row+=directions[direction][0];column+=directions[direction][1];if(row in 0 until rows&&column in 0 until cols)answer[count++]=intArrayOf(row,column)};direction=(direction+1)%4};steps++};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<vector<int>> spiralMatrixIII(int rows,int cols,int rStart,int cStart){vector<vector<int>> answer{{rStart,cStart}};int directions[4][2]={{0,1},{1,0},{0,-1},{-1,0}},direction=0,steps=1,row=rStart,column=cStart;while((int)answer.size()<rows*cols){for(int twice=0;twice<2;++twice){for(int move=0;move<steps;++move){row+=directions[direction][0];column+=directions[direction][1];if(row>=0&&row<rows&&column>=0&&column<cols)answer.push_back({row,column});}direction=(direction+1)%4;}++steps;}return answer;} };
